Delivery Delays Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Delivery estimates
Every order shows an estimated delivery date at checkout. The estimate already includes the seller's handling time and the carrier's transit time.

Delivery Delays Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - When an order is late
- **Up to 7 days past the estimate:** apologise, share the current tracking status, and confirm a new expected date with the carrier.
- **More than 7 days past the estimate:** in addition, the customer may receive a **R$20 delay voucher** (code issued by support, valid 60 days, minimum next purchase R$60).
- **More than 15 days past the estimate, or 30 days after purchase with no delivery:** the customer may choose a **full refund** instead of waiting. See *Order Not Received*.

Delivery Delays Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - What support must not do
- Do not promise a specific delivery date unless the carrier has confirmed it.
- Do not blame the carrier publicly; the marketplace is responsible for the customer experience.

Order Not Received Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Opening an investigation
If tracking shows no movement for 5 business days, or the order is past its estimated date and not delivered, support opens a carrier investigation within **2 business days**.

Order Not Received Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Resolution
- If the parcel is confirmed lost or stolen, the customer chooses between **reshipping the same item at no cost** or a **full refund** (product + shipping).
- Refunds are issued to the original payment method within **10 business days** of the decision. Credit card refunds on installment purchases appear as credits on the next card statements.
- If the order is more than 30 days old with no delivery, the customer may request a full refund immediately, without waiting for the investigation.

Order Not Received Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Communication
Support updates the customer at least every 3 business days until the case is closed.

Returns and Refunds Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Right of withdrawal (any reason)
Following Brazil's Consumer Defense Code (CDC, Art. 49), customers may return any item bought online within **7 days of receiving it**, for any reason. Return shipping is free and the refund includes the original shipping cost.

Returns and Refunds Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Defective items
Under CDC Art. 26, customers can claim for defects within **30 days** for non-durable goods and **90 days** for durable goods. Return shipping is free. The customer chooses a **replacement** or a **full refund**.

Returns and Refunds Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Refund timing
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within **10 business days** after the returned item reaches the seller, or immediately when no return is required (see *Damaged or Defective Items*).

Returns and Refunds Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Exchanges
Exchanges for a different size or colour are handled as a return plus a new order, subject to stock.

Damaged or Defective Items Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Reporting
Customers should report damage or a defect with **photos** through the order page. Damage visible on arrival (broken item, leaking bottle, crushed box with damaged contents) should be reported within **7 days** of delivery when possible; defects found later follow the CDC deadlines in *Returns and Refunds*.

doc: Damaged or Defective Items Policy (Aurora Marketplace)
text:
Damaged or Defective Items Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Resolution
- The customer chooses a **free replacement** or a **full refund**.
- For items under **R$50**, the customer does not need to send the item back; the refund or replacement is processed after the photos are reviewed.
- Suspected counterfeit or non-original items are escalated to the Seller Quality team and the listing is reviewed.

Damaged or Defective Items Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Packaging-only damage
If only the outer box is damaged and the product works, apologise and record the case against the seller's packaging score. No compensation is required, but a goodwill voucher may be offered under *Retention and Goodwill Offers*.

Wrong or Missing Items Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Missing items or partial deliveries
Orders with several items may ship in separate parcels. Check tracking for each parcel first. If an item is confirmed missing, the seller ships it within **5 business days**, or the customer receives a **partial refund** for that item plus the proportional shipping cost.

Wrong or Missing Items Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Wrong item, colour, size or model
If the customer received something different from the listing, the seller arranges **free return shipping** and sends the correct item, or the customer receives a **full refund**. The customer chooses.

doc: Wrong or Missing Items Policy (Aurora Marketplace)
text:
Wrong or Missing Items Policy (Aurora Marketplace) - Product different from the description
If the product does not match the listing (material, size, specifications), treat it as a wrong item. The listing is flagged for review by the Seller Quality team.

Retention and Goodwill Offers (Aurora Marketplace) - Allowed offers
- **R$15 goodwill voucher:** first-order customers who left a 1-2 star review.
- **R$30 goodwill voucher:** customers whose order value was **R$300 or more** and who had a negative experience.
- **R$20 delay voucher:** only for delays of more than 7 days (see *Delivery Delays*). Do not combine it with a goodwill voucher; offer the higher one.

Retention and Goodwill Offers (Aurora Marketplace) - Rules
- Vouchers are valid for **60 days** with a **minimum next purchase of R$60**.
- **One goodwill voucher per customer every 6 months.**
- Never offer cash, discounts on the current order, or amounts other than those listed here.
- Vouchers complement the resolution (refund, replacement); they never replace it.
- Customers who are already being refunded for fraud or abuse are not eligible.

Seller Communication and Escalation (Aurora Marketplace) - Seller response time
Sellers must answer customer messages within **2 business days**.

Seller Communication and Escalation (Aurora Marketplace) - Escalation
If a seller does not answer within 2 business days, or the customer reports that requests for a return, exchange or cancellation were ignored, marketplace support takes over the case and contacts the customer directly within **1 business day**.

Seller Communication and Escalation (Aurora Marketplace) - Cancellations
Orders can be cancelled free of charge before shipping. If a cancellation was requested but the item was still delivered, follow *Returns and Refunds* (right of withdrawal) at no cost to the customer.

Seller Communication and Escalation (Aurora Marketplace) - Seller accountability
Repeated complaints about the same seller (late shipping, wrong items, no response) are recorded on the seller's quality score and reviewed monthly by the Seller Quality team.

Customer Reply Guidelines (Aurora Marketplace) - Language and tone
- Reply in **Brazilian Portuguese**, in a warm and direct tone.
- Start with a short, specific apology that names the problem the customer described.
- Never blame the customer, the carrier or the seller in the reply.

Customer Reply Guidelines (Aurora Marketplace) - Content
- State the concrete next step and its deadline (for example, "abriremos uma investigação em até 2 dias úteis").
- Offer only resolutions and vouchers that the policies allow, with their exact amounts and conditions.
- If the case needs information we do not have (photos, order number, address), ask for it explicitly.
- If the situation is not covered by any policy, or the customer mentions legal action, consumer agencies (Procon) or a health/safety risk, **escalate to a human agent** instead of promising anything.

Customer Reply Guidelines (Aurora Marketplace) - Format
Three to six sentences. Sign as "Equipe Aurora".
